translation.name: Biblica® Ochiw Thuolo Motingʼo Loko Manyien™

content: Kuom jatend wer. Zaburi mar Daudi. Wer.

content.text: Mad Nyasaye aa malo, mad wasike ke;
mad joma kedo kode ring konene.
Mad iriembgi gi dhi mabor,
mana kaka yamo riembo iro tero mabor;
mad joma timbegi richo lal nono e nyim Nyasaye
mana kaka odok leny kowinjo mach.
To joma kare to mad bed mamor
kendo moil e nyim Nyasaye;
mad gibed mamor kendo gibed mamor chuth.
Weruru ne Nyasaye, weruru wende pak ne nyinge,
miyeuru duongʼ, En moriembo gechene e boche polo,
nyinge en Jehova Nyasaye,
beduru moil e nyime.
Nyasaye modak kare kama ler.
En wuoro ne joma onge gi wuonegi kendo en jachwak mon ma chwogi otho.
Nyasaye keto joma odongʼ kendgi e udi
kendo otelo ne joma otwe kower;
to joma ohero ngʼanyo to dak e piny ma chiengʼ otwoyo kururu.
Kane iwuok idhi kitelo ne jogi, yaye Nyasaye,
kane iwuotho e piny mokethore maonge tich, Sela
piny noyiengni
kendo polo noolo koth e piny,
e nyim Nyasaye, Jal man Sinai,
e nyim Nyasaye ma Nyasach Israel.
Ne ichiwo koth mogundho, yaye Nyasaye;
ne idwogo chuny girkeni mari mane ojony.
Jogi nokawo pinyno modakie kendo nichiwo ne joma odhier gik ma gilando,
kigolo kuom mwanduni mogundho, yaye Nyasaye.
Ruoth nolando wach kendo oganda mane okawo wachno
mi okeye ne duongʼ mokalo:
“Ruodhi gi jolweny dar gi ngʼwech;
ji pogo gik moyaki e kambi.
Kata mana sa ma inindo but mach kama liet,
to bwombe mag akuchena oum gi dhahabu,
kendo yierene oum gi fedha maleny.”
Kane Jal Maratego okeyo ruodhi manie piny,
to ne ochal mana gi pe molwar koa e kama otingʼore gi malo mar Zalmon.
Gode mag Bashan gin gode madongo miwuoro;
godego mag Bashan ojuothore adier.
Angʼo momiyo ungʼicho gi nyiego, yaye gode mojuothore,
angʼo momiyo nyiego omakou gi got kama Nyasaye oyiero mondo ogurie lochne,
kama Jehova Nyasaye owuon biro dakie nyaka chiengʼ?
Geche mag lweny mag Nyasaye gin tara gi tara;
gingʼeny mokalo akwana;
Ruoth osebiro koa Sinai mondo odonji kare maler.
Kane iidho idhi malo
to ne itelone joma nimako e lweny;
kendo ne ikawo mich mane ji omiyi,
nyaka mich mane jongʼanyo omiyi,
mondo in Jehova Nyasaye, idag kanyo.
Pak odog ne Ruoth, ma en Nyasaye ma Jawarwa,
Nyasaye matingʼonwa pekwa ndalo duto. Sela
Nyasachwa en Nyasaye ma waro ji;
tony e tho aa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto ma Wuon Loch.
Kuom adier, Nyasaye biro toyo wiye wasike,
obiro mayo joma dhi nyime gi timo richo osimbo motimo yier ma girwako.
Ruoth wacho niya, “Abiro gologi oko Bashan;
abiro gologi oko kama tut mar nam,
mondo unyum tiendeu e remb joma kedo kodu,
seche ma guogi magu olodho lewgi ka gichamo makorgi.”
Wuodhi koro nenore maler, yaye Nyasaye,
wuodh Nyasacha ma Ruodha nenore maler kodonjo kare maler.
Joma wer gi dhogi otelo eka joma wer ka goyo thumbe luwogi,
nyiri magoyo oyieke bende ni kodgi machiegni.
Pakuru Nyasaye e dier chokruok maduongʼ;
pakuru Jehova Nyasaye e dier chokruok mar jo-Israel.
Dhoot matin mar joka Benjamin otelonegi,
oganda maduongʼ mar ruodhi moa e dhood Juda bende ni kodgi,
eka nitie ruodhi moa e dhout Zebulun gi Naftali.
Chok tekoni kaachiel, yaye Nyasaye; nyiswa tekoni,
yaye Nyasaye; kaka isebedo kitimo nyaka aa chon.
Nikech hekalu mari man Jerusalem
ruodhi biro keloni mich.
Kwer ondiek manie dier togo,
kwer kweth mag rwedhi manie dier nyiroye mag ogendini.
Mi okel sirni mangʼeny mag fedha ka wiye okuot.
Ke ogendini mohero lweny.
Joote biro biro koa Misri;
Kush bende biro bolore ne Nyasaye.
Weruru ne Nyasaye, yaye pinjeruodhi mag piny,
weruru wende pak ne Ruoth Nyasaye, Sela
werneuru ne Jal mariembo gechene e kor polo malo manyaka nene,
Jal mamor gi dwol maduongʼ.
Landuru teko mar Nyasaye
ma nigi duongʼ kuom Israel,
kendo ma nigi teko e kor polo.
Ilich miwuoro ka in kari maler, yaye Nyasaye,
Nyasach Israel chiwo teko gi nyalo ne joge.
Pak mondo obed ne Nyasaye!
